review_policy: Component calibration, not a claim that one photographic style is universal. Semantic inputs are neutral in this pixel-only regression set.

fixtures.name: earth-timelapse-silent
fixtures.review: Strong graphic hierarchy and balance; severe clipped highlights and low-light softness must remain visible as technical cautions.

fixtures.name: goodnight-earth-vertical
fixtures.review: Deliberate negative space and dramatic placement; low exposure and clipped lunar edge reduce technical confidence.

fixtures.name: rocket-launch
fixtures.review: A recognizable decisive event with strong separation, but the representative frame is very dark, soft, and highlight-clipped.

fixtures.name: synthetic-speech
fixtures.review: Synthetic test-pattern control: technically crisp and balanced but almost no negative space. Semantic production scoring must determine story value rather than pixel heuristics pretending to know it.
